Title: Public preview: Advanced Container Networking Services for Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS)

Body.Content:
Microsoft’s Azure Container Networking team is excited to announce a new offering called Advanced Container Networking Services for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 

Advanced Container Networking Services is a suite of services built on top of existing networking solutions for AKS to address complex challenges around observability, security, and compliance. The first feature in this suite, Advanced Network Observability, is now available in Public Preview.

Advanced Container Networking Services enhances the operational capabilities of your AKS clusters and is designed to address the multifaceted and intricate needs of modern containerized applications.

For more details on Advanced Container Networking Services and its features, visit the documentation.
